zh.title: 美國航空使用廢二氧化碳電子永續航空燃料完成客運客機飛行
zh.summary: 美國航空首度使用廢二氧化碳製成之電子永續航空燃料完成客運航班。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）於2026年8月完成了一次客運客機飛行，該航班使用由廢棄二氧化碳（CO2）製成的燃料。此一舉動象徵著航空業在減碳與尋找替代能源方面的新進步，儘管其目前的經濟效益仍面臨顯著挑戰。
這次載客飛行標誌著電子永續航空燃料（eSAF）首次被遞送至美國的商業機場使用。此類新型燃料雖然利用廢棄的二氧化碳進行合成以達到減排效果，但其高昂的生產與使用成本依然是目前普及化的一大障礙。

en.title: American Airlines Operates Passenger Flight Using eSAF Made From Waste CO2
en.summary: American Airlines completes passenger flight using sustainable fuel made from waste carbon dioxide.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, American Airlines recently operated a passenger flight utilizing sustainable fuel made from waste carbon dioxide (CO2). This flight represents a new development in the aviation industry's efforts to find alternative energy sources and reduce carbon emissions, even though the current economics of the fuel remain a significant challenge.

The operation marked the first delivery of electronic sustainable aviation fuel (eSAF) to a commercial airport in the United States for use on a passenger flight. Although this type of fuel synthetic process recycles carbon dioxide, its extremely high production cost remains a barrier to widespread adoption.
